feed.title: NPR Topics: Climate
feed.subtitle: NPR's full coverage of climate change and related issues.

entry.title: One year after the end of the EV tax credit, is the future still electric?
entry.summary: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?

entry.title: How low-cost climate solutions are helping cities recover from major storms faster
entry.summary: Cities like New York are bouncing back faster from major rainfall and flash flooding, thanks to smart, low-cost climate solutions.

entry.title: Hurricane Polo's remnants bringing more rain to flood-struck U.S. Southwest
entry.summary: The storm's remnants battered the U.S. Southwest, flooding roadways and forcing residents in small New Mexico towns to evacuate over concerns about a dam failing.

entry.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
entry.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

entry.title: Mexico's Baja California braces for Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii
entry.summary: Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.

entry.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
entry.summary: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

entry.title: Years after storms, clean-up crews meticulously separate the sentimental from the wreckage
entry.summary: Across the country, lost-and-found networks seek to reunite objects with disaster survivors. The work can take years. In some cases, it's impossible to pick up all the pieces.

entry.title: The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is low. Here's why you should care
entry.summary: The U.S. has tapped into its strategic oil reserve to help drive down rising gasoline prices in the wake of the war with Iran. Can oil from Venezuela help fill it back up?

entry.title: Hurricane Polo fuels fears of landslides in Mexico as Nolo closes in on Hawaii
entry.summary: Southwestern Mexico braced for heavy rain and mudslides after Polo became a major hurricane. Forecasters warned another system headed for Hawaii could cause catastrophic flooding later in the week.

entry.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
entry.summary: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.
